5	    return f"{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"

8	def render_statement(customer_id, invoices):
9	    lines = [f"Statement for {customer_id}"]
10	    total = 0
11	    for inv in invoices:
12	        lines.append(f"  {inv['id']:<12} {format_cents(inv['total_cents']):>12}")
13	        total += inv["total_cents"]
14	    lines.append(f"  {'TOTAL':<12} {format_cents(total):>12}")
15	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
